_comment: All demand-side assumptions in one place. Change here, rerun make model. Sources in docs/methodology.md.
arrivals_note: Typical-weekday cyclist arrivals per campus. Derived as: on-campus population on a typical day x cycling mode share. City: ~40,000 students + ~7,000 staff present, students 1.5% (AT 2018 tertiary survey found 1% for UoA; e-bike growth since), staff 5% -> ~950; rounded 900. Grafton: ~4,000 FMHS students + ~1,200 staff/clinical, 2% and 6% -> ~150; rounded down to 140, as the City figure is. Newmarket: ~1,500 postgraduates/staff, 6% -> ~90. These scale the flows; the ranking of sites is insensitive to them, the dock counts are not.
portal_share_note: Share of arrivals attributed to riders living beyond the 3 km study window (entering via corridor portals). Auckland cycle commutes are typically 4-6 km, so most riders come from outside the window.
lambda_note: Exponential distance-decay constant on perceived (stress- and grade-weighted) cycling cost.
walk_decay_note: Credit a dock gives a destination building falls from 1.0 at 50 m network-walk to 0 at 250 m. NZTA cycle parking guidance asks for public parking within 25 m of the entrance and long-stay users tolerate more (CROW); 50/250 m is the compromise for secure, multi-building campus docks.
